sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the exact model as a Gemini 3 reasoning model, optimized for high-volume tasks. Its architecture section explicitly directs readers to Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite. Distribution is through Google applications and APIs; no weight download or numeric parameter count is supplied.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite API specifications
sources.evidence: For gemini-3.5-flash-lite, lists 1,048,576 input tokens and 65,536 output tokens; text, image, video, audio and PDF inputs; text output; supported thinking and function calling.

sources.title: Introducing Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber
sources.evidence: The July 21, 2026 announcement explicitly makes 3.5 Flash-Lite available that day in Gemini API, AI Studio, Android Studio, enterprise services and the Gemini app. It describes high-throughput agentic and document-processing use cases.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite model card
sources.evidence: The architecture reference explicitly named by the 3.5 Flash-Lite card. Its own architecture section directs readers to the Gemini 3 Pro model card. It provides no numeric total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro model card, updated May 2026
sources.evidence: The linked architecture reference describes a sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer with native multimodal support. It explains token routing to a subset of experts, without giving total or active parameter counts.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Google API access is governed by service-specific terms; extracting or replicating underlying model parameter weights is prohibited. Supports a descriptive proprietary classification, rather than an open-weight license.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Later September 2026 card checked for an exact 3.5 Flash-Lite size disclosure. Its model and evaluation sections provide no total or active parameter counts for 3.5 Flash-Lite; 3.8 Flash is a separate model based on 3.7 Flash.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon model card
sources.evidence: Later October 2026 card and comparison material checked for an exact 3.5 Flash-Lite parameter disclosure; none was found. Argon is expressly a separate new model and its specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
sources.evidence: Identifies this exact model in the Flash-Lite line, lists July 21, 2026 as the GA release, and corroborates its 1,048,576-token context, text output, multimodal inputs, thinking and function calling.

sources.title: Models.dev Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite record
sources.evidence: Baseline lead inspected. Contains the unhyphenated display name, normalized gemini-flash-lite family, date, input limit and capability flags; primary Google sources independently verify the factual specifications.

name.note: Use Google's official hyphenated model name.

developer.note: Google DeepMind publishes the model; Google is the existing developer normalization.

family.note: Normalized Flash-Lite subfamily within Gemini 3; distinct from the full Flash line.

release_date.note: Announcement states availability that day; corroborated by the exact API model release date.

open_weights.note: Official distribution is hosted applications/APIs under service terms, with no released checkpoint.

license.note: Descriptive classification for Google-controlled API access under Gemini API terms.

parameters_b.note: No numeric total for this exact variant was found in its card, referenced base cards, or later 3.8 Flash/4 Argon cards. Exact-model searches for parameter counts, technical reports, training and interpretability research did not reveal a first-party disclosure.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact-model active count is supplied by the reviewed first-party material. Sparse routing does not determine a numeric count; no sibling, expert-feature, or total count is substituted.

architecture.note: Explicit architecture-reference chain: 3.5 Flash-Lite -> 3.1 Flash-Lite -> Gemini 3 Pro. The final referenced card specifies a sparse MoE Transformer. This is an explicit architectural delegation, not a transfer of sibling parameter counts.

context_window.note: Exact documented input/context limit. The separate output maximum is 65,536 tokens.

modalities.note: Exact API data-type list, including PDF as the existing catalog document-input type. No audio or image generation.

reasoning.note: Thinking is explicitly supported; thinking levels permit adjusting inference effort.

description.value: Gemini Flash-Lite model with multimodal input, text output, thinking and function calling.

summary: Correct official name punctuation, fill proprietary license and sparse MoE architecture via the explicit model-card reference chain, and add primary provenance. Confirm July 21 release, 1,048,576-token input, five input types, text output, reasoning and function calling. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed after the reviewed model/base/later cards and exact-model research searches.
